body_markdown:
FearFest may be coming to a close at the end of October, but that doesn’t mean the spine-tingling fun has to end. Once Halloween has come and gone, head over to[Shudder](https://www.shudder.com/) to get your year-round horror fix, starting with Season of Screams, an annual celebration dedicated to expanding spooky seasonal the way through December. Whether it’s new series, new film premieres, seasonal specials, or cult classics, you’ll find every ghoulish delight imaginable right at your fingertips.


And if you act now, you can cash in on a scary good deal! Throughout Season of Screams, subscribers can save 70 percent by signing up for an Annual Plan on[Shudder.com](https://www.shudder.com/) for only $29.99. (That’s like $2.50 a month!) But hurry – while the scares never end on Shudder, the savings are only for a limited time.


**What should I watch on Shudder?** ******


[V/H/S/Mixtape](https://watch.shudder.com/interstitial/1014978) ******
In the mood for found footage horror? The 9th installment of the Shudder Original *V/H/S/Mixtape* is just what you’re looking for. Featuring all-new segments from legendary filmmaker Ernest Dickerson, hip-hop icon RZA, visionary director David Moreau and acclaimed filmmaker Renee Zhan, whose segment includes original puppets by Jim Henson’s Creature Shop, will keep your pulse racing.


***The Cycle*** **and** ***Big Baby*** ****
Looking for original films that fright and delight? Look no further than the Shudder Original[The Cycle](https://watch.shudder.com/interstitial/1024959) starring Deborah Ann Woll ( *Daredevil: Born Again* , *True Blood* ) where the loss of her estranged father leads her down a path of discovery and terror. Want something completely unhinged? Check out *Big Baby* , where nightmares of a maniac killer in a baby mask inspire a horror writer’s new script but may turn out to be more than just fiction.


[The Boulet Brothers’ Dragula](https://watch.shudder.com/series/3602?seasonId=33123) **Season 7**
Itching for some creative inspiration? The new season of *The Boulet Brothers’ Dragula* is back for Season 7, and this season features even more fabulous extreme drag artists from around the world competing in jaw-dropping challenges including costume design and creation, make up and special effects, live performance and craftsmanship.
